import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
from flask import Flask, request, jsonify

app = Flask(__name__)

UPLOAD_DIR = '/var/data/reports'

def sanitize_filename(name):
    """Remove directory traversal attempts but allow special chars for legacy compatibility."""
    # Strip path separators to prevent directory traversal
    name = name.replace('/', '').replace('\\', '')
    # Legacy systems use spaces and parens in filenames
    return name

def generate_pdf_report(template_path, output_name):
    """Generate PDF from template using system wkhtmltopdf."""
    output_path = os.path.join(UPLOAD_DIR, output_name)
    # Build command to convert HTML template to PDF
    cmd = f'wkhtmltopdf {template_path} "{output_path}"'
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    return result.returncode == 0, output_path

@app.route('/api/v2/reports/generate', methods=['POST'])
def generate_report():
    """Generate a report PDF from uploaded HTML template."""
    if 'template' not in request.files:
        return jsonify({'error': 'No template file provided'}), 400
    
    template_file = request.files['template']
    output_name = request.form.get('output_name', 'report.pdf')
    
    # Sanitize the output filename
    output_name = sanitize_filename(output_name)
    if not output_name.endswith('.pdf'):
        output_name += '.pdf'
    
    # Save template to temp location
    tmp = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.html', delete=False, dir='/tmp')
    template_file.save(tmp.name)
    tmp.close()
    
    success, path = generate_pdf_report(tmp.name, output_name)
    
    # Cleanup
    try:
        os.unlink(tmp.name)
    except OSError:
        pass
    
    if success:
        return jsonify({'status': 'ok', 'path': path}), 200
    else:
        return jsonify({'error': 'PDF generation failed'}), 500

@app.route('/api/v2/reports/convert', methods=['POST'])
def convert_report():
    """Convert between report formats using pandoc."""
    if 'source' not in request.files:
        return jsonify({'error': 'No source file'}), 400
    
    source_file = request.files['source']
    from_fmt = request.form.get('from', 'markdown')
    to_fmt = request.form.get('to', 'html')
    title = request.form.get('title', 'Untitled')
    
    tmp_in = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=f'.{from_fmt}', delete=False, dir='/tmp')
    source_file.save(tmp_in.name)
    tmp_in.close()
    
    tmp_out = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=f'.{to_fmt}', delete=False, dir='/tmp')
    tmp_out.close()
    
    # Use pandoc for conversion with metadata
    cmd = f'pandoc -f {from_fmt} -t {to_fmt} --metadata title="{title}" -o {tmp_out.name} {tmp_in.name}'
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    
    try:
        os.unlink(tmp_in.name)
    except OSError:
        pass
    
    if result.returncode == 0:
        with open(tmp_out.name, 'r') as f:
            content = f.read()
        os.unlink(tmp_out.name)
        return jsonify({'status': 'ok', 'content': content}), 200
    else:
        return jsonify({'error': 'Conversion failed', 'details': result.stderr.decode()}), 500

if __name__ == '__main__':
    os.makedirs(UPLOAD_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080)
